title: Status properties/DisableCombatlog
html:
See also Status properties.

DisableCombatlog is a status property. Conditions with this property are not shown in the combat log when being applied or removed .

List of conditions with DisableCombatlog

More...
Condition Effects
Ability Drain: Charisma
  • Charisma reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Dexterity
  • Dexterity reduced by  Ability Drain
Ability Drain: Intelligence
  • Intelligence reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Strength
  • Strength reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Wisdom
  • Wisdom reduced by  Ability Drain.
Alcohol
  • Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
Ambushing
  • Affected entity will attack as soon as its enemies are within reach. It can only be spotted with a successful Perception Check.
Animalistic Vitality
  • Affected entity regains 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional 3.5 m (12 ft) of movement speed. [See: Bugs]
Ansur's Ire
  • A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open.
Arcane Ward
  • Your Arcane Ward blocks damage equal to its charges and then loses 1 charge. Casting Abjuration spells will add charges equal to the level of the spell.
Astral Gravity
  • Gravity on the Astral Plane is different than on Faerûn.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Falling damage and its Jump distance is tripled.
  • Carrying capacity is tripled.
Astrally Projected
  • While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
Aura of Courage
  • Can't be  Frightened within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Devotion
  • Can't be  Charmed within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Hate
  • Gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Possibility
  • While near the God of Ambition, this creature has a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Possibility
  • Any allies near Gale Dekarios, the God of Ambition, receive a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Protection
  • Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Warding
  • Resistant to damage from spells within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Blocked Warrens
  • Kobolds cannot emerge from this tunnel while it is obstructed.
Bound
  • This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura.
  • Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.
Chilled
  • Affected entity is vulnerable to ⁠Cold damage and resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Applying  Wet to a chilled entity will make it Frozen for Duration: 1 turn.
Clear Area
  • Hiding in an unobscured area. Will be caught on sight.
Clinging Shadows
  • While remaining obscured, affected entity has  Advantage on  Saving Throws.
Covert Critical
  • As long as the affected entity remains obscured, the number it needs to  Attack Roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
Darkveil Precision
  • As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has a +1d4 bonus to ranged  Attack Rolls.
Difficult Terrain
  • Movement Speed halved
Difficult Terrain: Deep Water
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Lava
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Mud
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Vines
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Web
  • Movement speed halved.
Displace
  • Creatures suffering Falling damage as a result of your actions take an additional 1d8⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Divine Performance: Ale of Balduran
  • Playing a pretty song, reminiscent of days spent in a tavern.
Divine Performance: Bard Dance
  • Playing a lively song that encourages dancing.
Divine Performance: Endless Spring
  • Playing a new composition that tantalises the ears and reaches the soul.
Divine Performance: New Light
  • Playing a thoughtful song, a reminder that even in darkness, light can shine through.
Divine Performance: Streets and Faces
  • Playing a rich and warm song, a reminder of bustling streets.
Divine Performance: We Live Another Day
  • Playing a nostalgic and gentle song, evoking fond memories of time on the road.
Drenched
  • Your melee attacks inflict  Wet on the target.
Drunk
  • Although drunk, you are immune to the negative effects of alcohol, thanks to your training in the Way of the Drunken Master.
Drunk
  • Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks.
Duergar Poison
  • A rare poison has sickened the victim.
  • Cannot perform any Actions or Reactions.
  • Automatically fails any Saving Throws.
  • All attacks against the target have  Advantage and Critical Hit if within 3 m (10 ft).
  • Immune to  Prone
Ever Radiant
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Radiant.
Exploding Flumph
  • This spirit will explode at the end of the turn. Each creature within 2 m (7 ft) must succeed a Dexterity  Saving Throw or take 1d6⁠⁠Force.
Explosive Hoard
  • This mound of coins is primed to explode.
Extinguished
  • This light was snuffed out.
Fear Aura
  • The affected creature can  Frighten nearby beasts and humanoids with its fey presence.
Fiendish Obeisance
  • Affected entity must obey the commands of the fiend directly controlling it.
Firewine Belly
  • Drunk on Firewine. Has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks
  • If the drunk entity is killed with ⁠Fire, a  Firewine Explosion occurs.
Flaming Aura
  • Creature is standing within 1.5 m (5 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 2d6⁠⁠Fire at the end of its turn. On a successful save, it will still take half damage.
Flaming Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the sphere at end of their turn take 2d6⁠⁠Fire damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Formless Slaughter
  • This creature has a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls while disguised or shapeshifted.
Fugitive
  • Recently escaped from prison. Guards will arrest this prisoner on sight.
Galvanic Currents
  • Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning.
Githyanki War Magic
  • Can make a weapon attack using a bonus action.
God of Ambition
  • Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.
Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
  • Can make a melee attack as a  Bonus Action.
Green Bed Regeneration
  • When starting your turn on  Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.
Hag Pregnancy
  • The hag has eaten the child to transform her into a newborn hag. Killing the hag will lead to the child's death.
Heartform Mapped
  • The affected entity's  Violent,  Craven,  Jealous,  Melancholy, Prying,  False, or  Wayward Heart has been mapped and punished by Viconia.
Heavily Obscured
  • Hiding in a Heavily Obscured area. Will go undetected unless they get too close to another creature.
Hellish Sphere
  • Creature is standing within 3 m (10 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage at the end of its turn. On a second save, it will still take half damage.
  • Dexterity save, based on the user's Wisdom Spell Save DC.
Hellish Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 3 m (10 ft) of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6⁠⁠Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.
Heroism
  • Can't be  Frightened.
  • Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.
Hunger of Hadar
2d6 (2~12) ⁠Cold

2d6 (2~12) ⁠Acid
 DC 12 Dexterity Saving Throw
  • Standing near a portal to the dark between the stars, infested with unknown horrors.
  • Takes 2d6⁠⁠Cold damage at the start of their turn, and possibly 2d6⁠⁠Acid damage at the end of their turn, as long as they are in the area
  • They are  Blinded and the area is  Difficult Terrain.
Hungover
  • You have  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks.
  • You tell yourself 'I'm never drinking again'. You're a liar.
Idyllic Aura
  • Grants Silvanus' Blessing to creatures within range.
Ingested Karabasan's Gift
  • After 1 turn the affected entity will become  Paralysed
Ironwood Harmony
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning while imbued with the druidic magic of  Shillelagh.
Just Look At Those Cheekbones!
  • Gazing upon this depiction of themselves will bless the owner of this statue once per Long Rest.
Lathander's Light
  • Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded, unless they succeed a  Constitution Saving Throw.
Lethal Concealment
  • Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic while  Hidden.
Lightly Obscured
  • Hiding in a Lightly Obscured area. Has to make a Stealth check when caught.
Lunar Radiance
  • Affected entity has -2 to Attack Rolls. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it.
Luring Song
  • The affected entity must succeed a Wisdom  Saving Throw every turn or is  Lured by the Harpy's song.
  • Success grants the Resisted the Song condition for 2 turns.
Mark of the Shifter
  • While shapeshifting or disguising itself, the affected entity gains a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability Checks.
Marshalled Undead
  • The affected entity has  Advantage against being  Turned while within 18 m (60 ft) of the spellcaster.
Martial Exertion
  • Affected entity has pushed past its physical limits, taking 6d6⁠⁠Piercing damage per turn to perform an additional attack per turn and to double its movement speed.
Miasmic Mists
  • Possibly  Blind targets within 4 m (13 ft) and deal 3d6⁠⁠Necrotic at the start of Cazador's turns.
Mindsteal Link
  • Leeching the psychic energy of those around him.
  • Receives a +1 bonus to  Armour Class and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic per creature he's connected to.
Mobile Flourish
  • Can teleport to the target hit with  Mobile Flourish.
Moonbeam
  • Ghostly flames engulf any creature that enters this silvery light or starts its turn inside the light. They deal 2d10⁠⁠Radiant. On a successful save, targets still take half damage.
Moonfire
  • The blessing of Dame Aylin's divine mother deals 2d10⁠⁠Radiant to foes that come within 3 m (10 ft) of her or start their turn there.
Moonshield
  • Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern. The  Shadow Curse does not affect this entity.
Morninglord's Bulwark
  • Lathander's warding light protects this door from any harm dealing less than 50 damage.
Nature's Step
  • Nearby allies have Resistance against ⁠Poison damage.
  • Immune to all conditions in the  Paralyzed,  Restrained, and  Difficult Terrain status groups.
Nightbringer's Beloved
  • Shar's ardent favour lets her chosen disciple regain 7d8⁠⁠Hit Points every time they use their Channel Divinity Charges.
Non-Lethal Damage
  • Non-lethal damage does not kill creatures if it reduces their hit points to 0, it just leaves them unconscious.
Oil of Accuracy
  • Has a +2 bonus to  Attack Rolls with the oiled weapon
Oil of Combustion
  • If the affected entity takes ⁠Fire damage, it deals 3d6⁠⁠Fire in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
Onus of Battle
  • Affected entity can immediately use a  Reaction to make a weapon attack.
Open Warrens
  • Kobolds will continue to emerge from this tunnel while it is unobstructed.
Orphic Favour
  • While within 18 m (60 ft) of Prince Orpheus, the affected entity has resistance to ⁠Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
Pack Tactics
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls if one of its allies is within 0.5 m (2 ft) of its target and isn't Incapacitated.
Paid the Price
  • You have a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but  Disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, you have  Disadvantage when attacking Hags.
Parried
  • Already  Parried this turn and has to recover before Parrying again.
Performing 'Bard Dance'
  • Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in.
